verdict.rationale: Box documents a public REST API at https://api.box.com/2.0 with OAuth 2.0 auth, a copy-paste curl quickstart, and an onboarding path to a first API call. First-party guides cover the operations an agent would drive: chunked uploads, shared links, collaborations, search, metadata, webhooks, events, Box AI and Box Sign. An llms.txt index is also live. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed standard paths.
